biotools.summary: PP-MAPS is an open-source workflow designed to extract and aggregate dynamic pharmacophore signatures from molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories of protein-peptide complexes. It helps characterize protein-peptide interactions critical for drug discovery by producing per-residue interaction frequencies and pharmacophore heatmaps.
biotools.name: PP-MAPS: Dynamic Pharmacophore Signatures
